title: Quality control of glycogen through direct ubiquitylation by RNF213.

verified.what_i_actually_checked: Europe PMC record (PMID 42744304): not open access, no full text, no supplement, no text-mined accessions, no NCBI links (GEO/SRA/BioProject). EMDB (Electron Microscopy Data Bank) API search found 8 released entries EMD-55686 to EMD-55693 (Yip, Naydenova, Randow; released 2026-09-30): one composite cryo-EM map of murine RNF213 bound to maltoheptaose plus focused refinements. PRIDE (proteomics archive) search for 'RNF213 glycogen' returned nothing. Map files themselves not downloaded.
verified.what_came_from_paper_text_only: Everything about mouse knockouts, polyglucosan accumulation in brain regions, cell-based ubiquitylation assays, CBM20 (carbohydrate-binding module 20) mutants, LUBAC epistasis and autophagy receptor recruitment comes from the abstract only; no tables or counts were seen.

a1_downloadable.note: Cryo-EM maps are public in EMDB (checked via API); any other data (imaging, blots) not found in a repository and the paper is paywalled.

a2_label_is_a_column.note: No tabular dataset exists. The deposits are one protein–sugar structure (8 maps of the same complex); any ML label would have to be constructed from scratch. Checked in EMDB, not in files.

a3_inputs_present.note: There is no feature table; only a density map and (presumably) a model of one complex.

a4_units_stated.note: No measured quantity table to carry units; nothing found.

a5_enough_rows.note: One structure of one complex; mechanistic experiments are low-n mouse and cell assays per the abstract. Far below ~400 rows.

a6_fits_laptop.working_set: a few hundred MB of maps (not checked)
a6_fits_laptop.note: Size not an issue; irrelevant given A2/A5.

a7_counts_match_paper.note: No counts available to compare; full text not accessible.

a8_label_provenance.note: Data are direct experimental measurements (cryo-EM), but there is no label to trace.

honest_claim_h3: No ML claim is possible: the deposited data is a single cryo-EM structure of RNF213 bound to a sugar chain, not a set of labelled examples.

plain_idea.one_liner: Use protein sequence and structure to predict which carbohydrate-binding domains bind linear versus branched glycogen chains.
plain_idea.train_on: Would need many protein–carbohydrate binding measurements; this paper provides one structure (unknown number of binding assays, none deposited).
plain_idea.predict: Whether a carbohydrate-binding domain prefers linear sugar chains; truth would come from binding assays not present in this paper's public data.
plain_idea.why_worthwhile: Could flag other enzymes that police abnormal glycogen, but this paper supplies no training data for it.

label_elsewhere.why: Not assessed because Part A failed.

ml_idea: None viable from this paper's data: it is a mechanistic study whose only public deposit is one cryo-EM structure (8 related maps in EMDB).

effort.compute_note: Not estimated; no dataset to model.
effort.cheapest_killing_check: EMDB/PRIDE/NCBI search for deposits: only one structure found, which already kills it.

verdict_reason: Mechanistic, paywalled experimental paper; the only public data is one cryo-EM structure of RNF213 with maltoheptaose (EMDB EMD-55686–55693), so there is no label column and no rows to learn from (fails A2, A3, A5).
